resources.string: Sends a summary of each trip you record in OsmAnd to your Telegram chat when you tap Finish.
Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Then send /start to your bot and tap Detect to fill in your chat id.
✅ Route Logger is connected. Trip summaries will arrive here.
Enter the bot token and chat id first
the bot has no messages yet, send it /start and try again
Send a summary when a recording is saved
Reports each track trip recording saves to tracks/rec when you tap Finish. Pausing sends nothing. Only tracks that end after you first turn this on are reported.
